 Videos Now Available
 An Origins Project Dialogue with Mariette DiChristina

 We are pleased to announce videos are now available from our Dialogue with Mariette
 DiChristina on April 22 discussing the role of science in our life and how to better fuse
 the relationship between science and journalism in the digital age. Click the following
 link to view part 1 of this Origins Project Dialogue. To access both parts 1 and 2,
 please visit the Dialogue event one.




 Thank You
 2015-2016 Season Wrap-Up Video & Intographic

 On behalf of the Origins Project, thank you for an amazing 2015-2016 season. We
 hosted over a dozen public and private events, which attracted thousands of guests
 and millions of views online. From Antarctica to Phoenix, the Origins Project continues
 to explore fundamental questions facing humankind today. We couldn't reach these
 monumental successes without you, so we thank you for your continued support!
